people.why: The villain file skipped her departure: at the end of episode 3 she takes the name Madelyne Pryor and leaves the team, and only later is on Genosha in episode 5. The hero file's Independent stage is sourced, so both get it.

The screen tells that Magneto created the Savage Land Mutates years earlier (Reunion), so the villain file's past stage stays and the hero file gains it. Cortez's betrayal and the destruction of Asteroid M end his Acolytes, so the hero file's Independent stays. The villain file's last X-Men stage in season 1 is unsupported (X-Men '97 S1 summaries: after Genosha he turns his back on humanity from Asteroid M, and no summary shows him rejoining the team), so it is dropped.

On Sakaar Loki serves the Grandmaster (sent to hunt Thor and Hulk) before betraying him, then joins Korg's rebels, so the villain file gains Sakaar and Korg's revolution; the hero file gains the Asgard past and its Chitauri past re-keyed to its first title, Thor: The Dark World. He abandons the TVA in Loki S1 to follow Sylvie (Independent, which the hero file lacked) and only works with the TVA again in Loki S2 (back at HQ in S1 they don't know him), so the last TVA stage is keyed to Loki S2 in both.
